summary: I own technical standards and cross-squad system design, and I am the tiebreaker on build-versus-buy. Before that I spent four years shipping across every layer of the platform.

impact.title: Identity
impact.text: An org-wide single sign-on standard, and an enterprise identity service speaking SAML and SCIM.

impact.title: Developer platform
impact.text: An edge proxy, canary releases, and a reusable CI/CD template with audit-ready merge rules that other teams adopt in minutes.

impact.title: Patient onboarding
impact.text: A visual flow builder with conditional logic, used across four care programs.

impact.title: Pharmacy
impact.text: Integration design, plus a fix for roughly a third of prescription renewals.
